description: Orc clients: blunt, loud, boastful. Short sentences, big claims, honour and pay stated plainly.

o-hail: Ha! You look like you can take a job.
I do not like talking. Listen.
Hah! You made it past my guards.
Captain! Let me look at you.
o-intro: I am {client}. My name is known.
{faction} needs a hard hand, so here I am.
I'm {client}. I have done bigger things than this.
My name is {client} and I've never lost a fight I wanted.
I lead the loud end of {faction}.
o-frame: I have a job. It's good.
I need something done. Fast and loud.
It's easy for me, but I'm busy.
It's a good job for someone brave. Or stupid.
I'd do it myself, but I'm too important.
o-clock: Do it in {deadline}, or I'll get angry.
o-stakes: If you're late, I look weak, and I never look weak.
If it takes longer, it costs me a fight.
I won't have it said we were slow.
o-offer: I'm giving {reward}. Don't spend it all in one bar.
{reward}! More than your last captain paid.
It pays {reward}, and I always pay.
o-terms: Do the work. Get the coin.
I keep my word, ask anyone.
My word is better than paper.
You'll get it in my hands, not in a drawer.
o-boast: Nobody pays better, and I've checked.
Do well and you'll drink on me.
You'll tell your friends about it.
o-caution: Some will try to stop you. Stop them first.
Don't trust anyone smaller than you.
Not everyone likes me. They'll like you less.
o-conseq: If you run away, I'll find you.
Fail and I'll be very loud about it.
Cross me and see what happens.
Don't take my coin and sleep.
Betray me and my whole clan will know.
o-send: Show them what you're made of.
o-part: Don't die. It's bad for business.
Win, and I'll sing about you.
Do not make me regret it.
